variants.label: Минимализм
variants.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: website mascot logo proposal for the existing SealCode website, isolated transparent PNG.
Input image 1: existing logo, visual identity reference and edit target.
Primary request: carefully redraw and subtly improve this logo, preserving the instantly recognizable friendly SEAL wearing over-ear headphones behind a laptop with the exact code glyph "</>". Keep the compact front-facing seated pose, small side flippers, rounded seal head, dark little eyes, whiskers and simple happy muzzle. Remain minimalist.
Style/medium: polished flat vector-like raster logo, confident consistent moderately thick charcoal outlines, smooth clean curves, deliberately simple geometry and very few colors. One seal only. No text except the code glyph on laptop. Slightly lighter cool slate-grey seal body for clear visibility against dark site backgrounds, charcoal headphones and laptop, clean pale code glyph. Stay close to the source palette; no additional brand colors. Friendly but not childish.
Composition: one centered compact mascot, whole silhouette and headphones fully visible, balanced proportions, tight comfortable transparent margins. The mark should read clearly at around 90px width.
Improvements: clearer symmetrical face, simplified whiskers, cleaner flippers, more coherent outline thickness, crisper laptop and unmistakable </> mark.
Background: actual fully transparent alpha outside the mascot. Remove the source's opaque dark rectangular background AND the ground shadow/oval under the seal. Empty areas and gaps must be transparent, no floor, backdrop, circle, badge, glow, halo, gradient or checkerboard baked into pixels.
Avoid: photorealism, 3D, texture, decorative details, extra objects, extra limbs, text labels, wordmark, watermark, presentation board. Output the standalone finished logo image only.

variants.label: Pixel Art
variants.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: alternative website mascot logo for SealCode, true transparent PNG, minimalist pixel-art redesign.
Input image 1: existing SealCode logo, identity reference.
Primary request: redraw the existing friendly seal in over-ear headphones behind its laptop as tasteful minimalist pixel art. Preserve the recognizable frontal seated seal, tiny flippers, headphones, little dark eyes and muzzle, and exact white "</>" symbol centered on laptop.
Style/medium: authentic clean pixel art with a consistent visible square-pixel grid, as if drawn at approximately 96 x 80 pixels then enlarged using nearest-neighbor. Hard crisp stepped contours, flat color clusters, maximum 6 colors including charcoal outline, cool medium slate grey body, pale muzzle/highlights and white code glyph. NO gradients, no soft edges, no anti-aliasing or soft shadows. Simple generous silhouettes, very few pixels for whiskers and face. Logo-quality restraint, appealing friendly personality.
Composition: one centered mascot only, whole silhouette and headphones visible, tight comfortable transparent margin; compact balanced mark that remains legible at 90px width. Stay close to the source's cool grey palette, slightly lighter seal body for dark website backgrounds. No additional brand colors.
Background: actual fully transparent alpha around and between shapes. Remove the existing opaque dark rectangular backdrop AND any ground shadow or oval under the mascot. No scene, ground, badge, enclosing circle, glow, halo, checkerboard pattern or decorative floating pixels.
Text: only the exact code glyph "</>" on the laptop, rendered in crisp white pixel strokes, no brand wordmark or labels.
Avoid: 3D, realism, excessive dithering, small noisy details, glossy highlights, text outside laptop, watermarks, sprite sheets or multiple variants in one image. Output a single standalone finished logo.

transparency: Generated alpha channel preserved without postprocessing.
